summary: Baozun Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing the grant of 150,000 restricted share unit awards (RSUs) to certain directors under its 2022 share incentive plan. The RSUs, representing 0.09% of total issued shares, were granted on May 21, 2026, with no purchase price required. Grantees include independent directors Yiu Pong Chan, Steve Hsien-Chieng Hsia, Benjamin Changqing Ye, and executive director Bin Yu. The RSUs vest into Class A ordinary shares (or ADSs). This is a routine equity grant, not a special situation.
